_readme: Copy this file to auth-config.json (same folder) and fill in real values — that file is gitignored, never commit real credentials. Generate a passwordHash on the server (or on any machine with PHP, then upload the file) with: php -r "echo password_hash('your-password-here', PASSWORD_DEFAULT), PHP_EOL;" — role is 'full_admin', 'full_editor', or 'limited_editor' (defaults to 'limited_editor' if omitted or unrecognized). Once at least one full_admin account exists, the rest can be managed from the admin page itself (Users tab).
